Definition: from G1223 and G5316; appearing through, i.e. "diaphanous":--transparent.
BiblicalUsage: This word means transparent, clear as glass, and it is the word the King James translators used for the street of the new Jerusalem, pure gold as it were transparent glass. It belongs to the Received Text, where the verse reads transparent; the Greek text most modern Bibles follow uses a closely related word for clear instead.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the picture stands even so; the city of God is clear as crystal, and whether the word is transparent or clear, the promise is the same: nothing hidden, nothing clouded, in the city where God dwells.
